## Employment

<div class="cv-section">

**2021–Present** &emsp; Senior Data Scientist, [Karna](https://karna.com), Atlanta, GA

- Engineered a document intelligence microservice that automated clinical document extraction (Azure Document Intelligence, Textract) and AI-powered synthetic data generation (GPT-4); deployed on ECS with schema enforcement and data validation to protect downstream quality.
- Built compliant Snowflake data infrastructure and SQL-based ETL pipelines using Python, R, and shell scripting to ingest multi-source clinical datasets and surface opioid use trends, program utilization metrics, and drug co-occurrence patterns supporting national federal opioid response planning.
- Designed and deployed a HIPAA/NIST-compliant ML pipeline for maternal CVD risk stratification on Azure, with automated drift monitoring and a Flask API; migrated from SQLite to PostgreSQL in production; applied causal inference (ITS and diff-in-differences) to measure the program's impact on emergency care utilization.
- Partnered with data science, research and evaluation, and health communications teams to design and run A/B message testing for CDC NCIRD's COVID Vaccine Task Force; tested message variants across hesitancy segments, political ideology, and demographics using ordered logistic regression; findings directly shaped national vaccine communication decisions.
- *Awards: [President's Award (2023)](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/karnallc_2023-karna-annual-awardees-activity-7146207174480785409-j72w), [Technical Achievement Award (2023)](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/karnallc_2023-karna-annual-awardees-activity-7146207174480785409-j72w), [Community Engagement Award (2022)](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/karnallc_karnallc-publichealth-2022awards-activity-7014680288492421120-ZHZD), [Outstanding Publication runner-up (2022)](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/karnallc_karnallc-publichealth-2022awards-activity-7014680288492421120-ZHZD), Technical Achievement runner-up (2024)*

**2021–Present** &emsp; Lecturer, [University of Washington, Department of Sociology](https://sociology.washington.edu), Seattle, WA

- Designed and taught applied labs on behavioral and digital trace data analysis (Google Trends, Fitbit, sensor data), data visualization, NLP, and algorithmic fairness; challenged students to interrogate models for potential bias from training data, historical inequities, and deployment context.
- Designed and ran in-class randomized experiments (A/B tests) covering random assignment, hypothesis testing, and power analysis, demonstrating how controlled experimentation underpins data-driven product and policy decisions and where purely observational analysis falls short.

**2020–2021** &emsp; Senior Policy Advisor, Office of Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo, Houston, TX

- Automated COVID-19 surveillance reporting by replacing hand-transcribed web data and manual multi-source joins with a reproducible R pipeline ingesting DSHS, HCPH, and national datasets, reducing processing latency by 90% and enabling real-time data quality for policymakers.
- Applied statistical modeling to evaluate county-wide housing initiatives, projecting $6 million in annual savings from permanent supportive housing proposals.

**2020–Present** &emsp; Principal, [Atlas Analytics](https://www.analyticsbyatlas.com/), Houston, TX

- Built a Python/SQL entity resolution pipeline joining fragmented SBA datasets with merchant registries via a tiered probabilistic matching algorithm (86% recall on a manually labeled hold-out set), enabling downstream customer analytics and market segmentation.
- Built data pipelines integrating a 2.2M-member consumer transaction panel (Earnest Analytics), device mobility data (SafeGraph), and COVID policy records; analyzed user acquisition and retention cohorts to quantify COVID-19's long-term impact on consumer behavior across 12 categories; acknowledged for research assistance in Oblander & McCarthy, *Marketing Science* (2023).

**2018–2020** &emsp; Data Scientist, MAANA, Houston, TX

- Partnered with solutions architects to engineer and deploy containerized ML microservices (Docker, Kubernetes) powering a real-time vessel routing optimizer across global multi-port routes, with ingestion pipelines parsing Q88 XML and integrating live weather, war-risk, and port data to cut fleet planning from hours to minutes; cost forecasting on historical trades projected $100M in annual savings.

**2017–2018** &emsp; Postdoctoral Researcher, [Università Bocconi](http://www.dondena.unibocconi.it/wps/wcm/connect/Cdr/Centro_Dondena/Home), Milan, Italy

- Carlo F. Dondena Centre for Research on Social Dynamics and Public Policy
- Engineered multi-source data fusion pipelines from social media APIs and digital trace data to produce high-frequency population estimates and evaluate policy outcomes at scale.

**2016–2017** &emsp; Program Manager, eScience Institute, Data Science for Social Good, Seattle, WA

- Organized program resources, created student selection process, and scheduled activities.
- Coordinated with industry partners to incorporate real-world data science challenges into projects.
